notes: Ten two-option questions. correctAnswer must be set to 0 or 1 by Susan before any scoring or public release. Current live quiz uses four choices and remains unchanged.

questions.question: When I'm eating something I really like, what happens to the best bite?
options: I save it for the very end
I eat it first, before anything else

questions.question: If someone says 'we need to talk' with absolutely no context, what do I do first?
options: Replay every conversation to find out what I did
Reply 'about what?' and refuse to overthink it

questions.question: If I discover a song that hits perfectly, what do I actually repeat?
options: One exact ten-second part
The entire song from the beginning

questions.question: When I get a message I wasn't expecting at 2 AM, what do I check first?
options: The sender's name
The notification preview

questions.question: If there's only one bite left of something I love, what do I do?
options: Offer it to the other person
Keep the last bite for myself

questions.question: If an argument ends and I think of the perfect comeback five minutes later, what happens?
options: I send it anyway
I save it for a future argument

questions.question: If I wake up and see 12 missed messages from the same person, what's my first instinct?
options: Read the last message first
Scroll up and start at the beginning

questions.question: When I need to pick between two equally good options, what breaks the tie?
options: A tiny, oddly specific detail
Whichever option I saw first

questions.question: If my phone is at 1% but I'm in the middle of a good conversation, what do I do?
options: Find a charger and keep talking
Send a dramatic goodbye before it dies

questions.question: If I accidentally send a message to the wrong chat, what's my first move?
options: Delete it immediately and pretend nothing happened
Explain myself before they can react
